scope.contract: Every control discovered by the checker is registered exactly once with an owner, rationale, revisit condition, and current classification. scientific-choice entries remain explicit because they select a different mathematical approximation or an explicitly declared source/target initialization policy; execution-only choices may be promoted only through evidence-bound guards. Registration is policy bookkeeping only and never constitutes performance or numerical promotion.

entries.rationale: The native DF-CCSD(T) owner may preconverge a detached density with a separately bundled H/C JK-fit basis, only for neutral spherical through-f 200–400 AO cold references. The accepted RHF reference, Hamiltonian and complete analytic response remain unscreened FP64 Direct. Preliminary work is finite and included in reference/endpoint timing; unsupported topology, tight budgets and refused guesses retain Direct. Explicit or warm density seeds take precedence.
entries.revisit_condition: Expand the topology/resource domain only with independent reference/force gates and paired complete endpoint evidence, including a larger planner case. Never interpret this policy as promotion of a fitted accepted reference or DF-HF gradients.

entries.rationale: The exact incremental Direct-J/K implementation is merged via #990/#1579, but automatic selection remains unqualified: bounded-streaming provider-owned accounting, matched complete endpoints, RHF/UHF workload coverage, geometry-change behavior, and composition with precision policy still require a promotion decision under #1598.
entries.revisit_condition: Reclassify only after #1598 retains complete cold, warm, and changed-geometry endpoint evidence with numerical parity and a workload/resource guard, or records durable negative evidence and keeps the route opt-in.

entries.rationale: The incremental XC anchor/update route is an experimental controller and is not a public/default execution policy.
entries.revisit_condition: Revisit after complete-solve numerical and endpoint qualification demonstrates a profitable guarded domain without weakening final-state or force checks.

entries.rationale: The public precision=auto mode is explicit opt-in. HF retained evidence is not sufficient for a global default, while DFT precision has independent admission gates.
entries.revisit_condition: Promote only a source-identified workload domain with repeatable full-endpoint benefit, executed lower-precision work, unchanged convergence gates, and strict FP64 opt-out.

entries.rationale: The environment threshold is a legacy diagnostic/qualification override. Product policy is the explicit public precision request, not an environment-variable default.
entries.revisit_condition: Retire the override after all retained qualification and audit workflows use the public precision policy and no historical reproduction depends on it.

entries.rationale: These controls force reference, tracing, validation, profiling, or qualification behavior. They are audit surfaces rather than candidates for automatic product policy.
entries.revisit_condition: Remove individual controls when their diagnostic or reproducibility role disappears; do not promote them merely because the underlying optimized path becomes default.

entries.rationale: Normal direct-HF execution already selects bounded streaming when the fixed descriptor grid or its memory budget requires it; the environment variable is an explicit schedule override.
entries.revisit_condition: Retire the override after forced-path endpoint qualification no longer needs it; changes to automatic admission still require matched endpoint evidence.

entries.rationale: Same-binary RTX 5090 ABBA diagnostics regress complete TZVPD E/F warm by 29.15% at 3 atoms and 10.063% at 12 atoms despite passing independent numerical gates. Linked registers remain 254-255 and enumeration repeats thirteen times.
entries.revisit_condition: Only revisit with a materially different work/resource argument that removes the demonstrated tradeoff; do not retune or promote the unchanged thirteen-scan design.

entries.rationale: Off-by-default exact Cartesian component dependency pruning. Primitive/AO counts and reserved auxiliary storage stay unchanged; recurrence state counts are not FLOPs or measured speedups.
entries.revisit_condition: Independent full/LR derivative, sanitizer, complete same-binary cold/warm/displaced and larger-size qualification with observed work must precede promotion.

entries.rationale: Default-off Cartesian pair-axis convolution for generic strict-FP64 orders five and higher. Values and derivatives have separate explicit choices; primitive/AO admission and radial ownership are unchanged. Static contribution counts are not FLOPs or endpoint predictions.
entries.revisit_condition: Independent generated value/xyz-jet and full/LR molecular oracles, sanitizer, frozen policy/fallback checks, actual work and same-binary complete cold/warm/displaced/larger endpoint evidence before any promotion.

entries.rationale: Force density-product screening has correctness coverage but retained endpoint evidence did not justify enabling it automatically.
entries.revisit_condition: Reconsider only with new complete force-endpoint evidence that crosses the shared performance gate under unchanged force accuracy and screening semantics.

entries.rationale: These shell-class schedule overrides remain explicit experiments/ablation controls and lack one shared qualified workload guard for normal execution.
entries.revisit_condition: Assign a narrower owner and reclassify each selector when complete endpoint evidence either admits a guarded default or records a durable negative decision.

entries.rationale: Generated one-electron execution is production-owned; these mapping variables preserve measured/reproduction schedule overrides rather than a second scientific implementation.
entries.revisit_condition: Retire overrides when retained evidence no longer requires forced mappings and the automatic compiler-owned path remains independently auditable.

entries.rationale: Unset/auto behavior for these DF selectors is resolved by existing qualified production policies; explicit values retain diagnostic, reproduction, or forced-comparison routes.
entries.revisit_condition: Revisit per selector when its automatic guard or evidence identity changes; do not infer that every explicit override is itself production-qualified.

entries.rationale: These selectors expose reference validation, fixed block-size/storage ablations, verification, or raw-source reuse controls and are not standalone automatic-promotion targets.
entries.revisit_condition: Retire them when the corresponding retained evidence or debugging workflow no longer needs a forced comparison path.

entries.rationale: Alternative generated DF value mappings/math remain explicit candidates after retained cold complete-endpoint regressions; the established generic/scalar route remains the safe default.
entries.revisit_condition: Reopen only with new complete cold/warm/changed-geometry evidence that beats the current route without changing the scientific model or force gates.

entries.rationale: The earlier SSS primitive force screen is explicitly off by default; its small measured complete-endpoint gain does not establish automatic promotion. Whole-shell Coulomb-norm screening is registered separately.
entries.revisit_condition: Require changed-geometry force endpoints, resource accounting, and existing numerical gates before any nonzero automatic screening budget is admitted.

entries.rationale: Qualified whole-shell Coulomb-norm screening defaults to a 1e-10 absolute force-component budget on the established sm_120 automatic shell domain. Complete 96-atom warm endpoints improve 27.4%; independent numerical, geometry, batch and constrained-panel checks pass. Generic and capacity-limited consumers retain strict evaluation. The earlier SSS primitive screen remains independently off.
entries.revisit_condition: Broaden the architecture or workload domain only with complete endpoint and resource evidence. Preserve explicit off, unchanged tile selection and strict optional-allocation fallback; forward B storage is unchanged.

entries.rationale: TensorSchedule exposes explicit physical execution choices. Evidence exists for selected workloads, but normal planning must consume only identity-bound qualified winners and fail closed to the deterministic baseline.
entries.revisit_condition: Split/reclassify a schedule dimension when its production consumers have source/device/workload-bound evidence and normal planning encodes the exact admission guard.

entries.rationale: Both streaming schedules remain explicit memory-oriented alternatives. Retained RTX 5090 and H100 complete-endpoint evidence shows substantial runtime regressions against the deterministic baseline despite smaller arenas; the generated-reduction variant is still about 10.4x and 27.0x slower on the retained H100 workloads. Neither schedule belongs in default search.
entries.revisit_condition: Reconsider only after a new bounded cooperative/persistent lowering shares producer work and passes independent numerical, resource, and complete-endpoint gates on an identified workload domain; lower memory or launch counts alone do not justify promotion.

entries.rationale: TensorSchedule defaults direct_gemm to true, and ordinary plan_cuda uses that BASELINE_SCHEDULE. Existing layout and GEMM legality checks select direct execution when supported; direct_gemm=false retains the explicit packed comparison path.
entries.revisit_condition: Revisit when direct-GEMM legality, layout eligibility, or baseline policy changes; preserve the explicit packed opt-out and do not treat the already-default dimension as an unqualified opt-in.

entries.rationale: The CUB/CCCL reduction provider is qualification-only and retained evidence rejected the tested candidate; generated reduction remains the production/default provider.
entries.revisit_condition: Reconsider only after a new source/device/workload campaign crosses complete-endpoint and numerical gates; representability or a kernel microbenchmark is insufficient.

entries.rationale: Prepared TensorIR CUDA Graph replay is explicit opt-in; ordinary execution remains the safe default while retained graph resources and repeated complete-endpoint benefit are not a universal admission rule.
entries.revisit_condition: Promote only through a bounded capture/resource guard with repeated-endpoint benefit, identity-safe replay invalidation, and ordinary execution as the guard-miss fallback.

entries.rationale: Ordinary native KS requests up to 32 independent original XC tiles within an additional 32-MiB per-owner allowance. Compiler residency admission and the shared numeric resource ledger retain one-tile execution on tiny/response/mixed/resource-rejected domains; explicit zero/one tile or zero-byte overrides retain the incumbent. Independent E/V and complete cold/warm/moved PBE0 E/F gates pass, and retained endpoint populations show reduced time without added per-build AO/jet/contraction work. Point algebra and ordered accumulation are unchanged.
entries.revisit_condition: Refine resource/profitability admission using additional devices and workloads, not device or molecule-size whitelists. Retain opt-out, constrained-memory fallback and ordered E/V semantics. The small cold population, differing cold trajectories, hardware-counter permissions and separate #2072 composition remain disclosed follow-up qualification, not claims of universal profitability.

entries.rationale: Ordinary native KS requests compact mapped density/features and local Vxc contractions within the existing additional XC byte cap. Original point/AO maps and ordered FP64 accumulation remain unchanged. Independent native E/V, sanitizers and complete 12-atom PBE0 cold/warm/moved E+F populations pass; large-system warm populations remain within timing noise. Unsupported groups, response, mixed precision, optional providers and constrained public ledgers retain bounded fallback; an explicit zero control disables compact batching.
entries.revisit_condition: Refine the bounded scatter and residency domain with additional devices, methods and complete endpoints rather than molecule/device whitelists. Do not infer large-system or universal profitability from the small-domain positive population; retain zero opt-out, original selected work, numerical gates and resource fallback.

entries.rationale: Public CUDA DFT forces use one method-name-free and architecture-agnostic active-AO policy keyed by execution composition, spin, derivative order, provider/resource identity and a continuous dense-work cost proxy. Ordinary all-electron Direct RKS/UKS force execution with supported AO-jet orders 1/2 admits map discovery once predicted dense point×AO² work reaches the retained positive crossover; every capability/resource/profitability miss remains dense. CUDA architecture is recorded as workload provenance only and is not a selection predicate.
entries.revisit_condition: Refine the cost crossover with additional devices and workload shapes rather than adding architecture, molecule, atom-count, AO-count or grid-count windows. Broaden to composite execution, DF or ECP only with source/device-identified complete endpoint evidence; keep every unsupported or unprofitable case dense.

entries.rationale: Default-off canonical full J/K and range K joint traversal with one density projection and common high-order primitive geometry/Hermite preparation. Separate radial values and independent outputs remain; an optional two-spin Cartesian range matrix is charged after existing owners. No cross-AO cooperative source tile or derivative gain is claimed.
entries.revisit_condition: Actual executed candidate/radial counts and independent full/SR/LR matrices, both spins, screened/dense domains, budgets and alias gates; device sanitizers and same-binary complete cold/warm/displaced/larger endpoint evidence.

entries.rationale: Density fitting changes the finite numerical Hamiltonian through an auxiliary basis, Coulomb-metric factorization and threshold. The public default therefore remains direct/exact; selecting auto chooses a backend only after the caller has explicitly selected the density-fitted model.
entries.revisit_condition: Do not silently replace an exact/direct request with density fitting. Higher-level workflows may recommend or explicitly select DF only while preserving the auxiliary-basis and metric-threshold model identity.

entries.rationale: Seminumerical COSX changes the exchange approximation and carries an explicit quadrature/model-error identity. It is not an interchangeable execution provider for exact exchange and therefore must not be selected merely from a performance crossover.
entries.revisit_condition: Keep COSX explicit in the mathematical Fock request. Automatic provider selection may choose only among implementations of the already selected COSX model, never between exact exchange and COSX.

entries.rationale: HF/LDA preliminary SCF can reduce target iterations and has profitable measured domains, but it adds a second solve and can change the SCF trajectory/root. Existing evidence is intentionally domain-specific, so normal target execution must not silently insert it.
entries.revisit_condition: Promote only through an explicit source/model/workload guard with complete source+target endpoint benefit, unchanged final target-state gates, root/state comparison and deterministic cold fallback. Otherwise retain the explicit initial-guess request.

entries.rationale: Automatic MINAO is guarded to FP64 all-electron H-Ar restricted exact CPU HF/KS and CUDA KS. Existing densities take precedence, unsupported batches retain Hcore, the additional-phase numeric cap and single Hcore retry remain bounded, and explicit None rolls back. CUDA complete cold E+force evidence supports measured benefit; CPU uses the same scientifically admitted construction without claiming the CUDA speedup.
entries.revisit_condition: Revisit for root/state regressions, complete-endpoint regressions, or broader provider/domain qualification. Do not turn on HF/LDA preliminary solves, DF, UKS, ECP, mixed precision, or unsupported elements through this default.

entries.rationale: Cross-basis projection explicitly introduces a source calculation and transports an occupied subspace into the target metric. The target Hamiltonian is rebuilt, but the seed can alter the SCF basin and complete retained evidence does not show a universal workflow speedup.
entries.revisit_condition: Do not enable projection implicitly from a target Calculator. A declared progressive workflow may choose it only with an explicit source model, metric/rank validation, target-state verification and cold fallback.

entries.rationale: The common TensorIR proof safely retains immutable reference transforms within one conventional CPU solve, with unchanged dynamic amplitudes and independent replay. A corrected matched-budget CPU solve probe did not reproduce the initial noisy slower sign, but this bounded synthetic result does not establish representative molecular or GPU benefit. The schedule remains internal and default-off.
entries.revisit_condition: Require representative complete molecular endpoint benefit, full retained-memory accounting, unchanged physical replay and convergence, and real-device CUDA owner validation before promoting a backend. Do not infer an unmeasured shape threshold from the initial bounded probe.

entries.rationale: Restricted DIIS packing preserves the CC equations and materially lowers history capacity, but changes FP64 projection/summation order and has no demonstrated complete wall-time benefit. Its retained value is capacity admission, not latency.
entries.revisit_condition: Normal latency execution should keep full histories. Automatic packing may be promoted only as an identity-checked resource-budget fallback that proves the full-history route would exceed the admitted budget and preserves the existing symmetry, replay and numerical gates.

entries.rationale: Synchronized J/K timing and canonical-work census intentionally perturb execution for measurement and are observability surfaces, not production algorithm choices.
entries.revisit_condition: Retire or narrow the profiling switch when equivalent always-on low-overhead telemetry exists; never promote profiling itself into ordinary execution.

entries.rationale: Positive provisional orbital-response screening removes little work in the retained large endpoint and shows no meaningful response-time benefit while requiring an unscreened residual/refinement contract. Zero remains the justified default.
entries.revisit_condition: Reconsider only with a materially different screening/error model that removes substantial exact J/K work and passes complete force, exact-residual and endpoint gates across a declared workload domain.

entries.rationale: The one-pass canonical P:G'(D) experiment is numerically qualified at the retained endpoint but loses shell-level reuse: the measured nuclear two-electron phase regresses from 155.771 s to 258.643 s. The qualified two-pass shell schedule remains the default.
entries.revisit_condition: Do not retune or promote the unchanged canonical traversal. Revisit only after a materially different source/work decomposition restores shell/component reuse and demonstrates a complete-endpoint win.

entries.rationale: The stronger DF numerical inverse is exact-corrected but did not reduce representative large Z iterations or exact J/K action counts, so its setup/resource cost has no established large complete-endpoint benefit.
entries.revisit_condition: Reconsider only with a different preconditioner or workload guard that reproducibly reduces exact physical actions after charging setup, resource ownership and final audits.

entries.rationale: Strict same-operator recycling can reduce work on an identical retained frame, but representative large cold/warm frames miss the exact identity and show no general endpoint gain. Retained cache capacity is also charged before any possible hit.
entries.revisit_condition: Promote only behind exact reference/operator identity, bounded retained-resource admission and repeated complete-endpoint evidence for a real reuse domain; every miss must remain the ordinary exact solve.

entries.rationale: Only the qualified sm_120 profile prefers psps, ppps, dsss, dpss, dsps, ddss, dsds, dpps and dspp quartet-parallel Rys-K; other classes and profiles retain incumbent recurrence with the independently selected work/fill schedule. Three-root classes use one-word 64-bit component masks and bounded local contraction, with generic scatter beyond its private footprint. Construction freezes selection and coverage filters cannot broaden preference. Lowering incumbent disables task preference; also select task fill to roll back both promotions. A separately identified joint campaign qualifies task Work companions with independent matrices/sanitizers, complete cold E+F mean/median gains against both standalone policies and retained actual Fock counts. Historical separate promotions and rejected cohorts remain independently labeled rather than relabeled as joint qualification.
entries.revisit_condition: Any target/class expansion or queue/parallel-granularity change requires renewed source-identified numerical, sanitizer, work-count and complete-endpoint qualification. Keep frozen historical measurements distinct from current-master qualification and retain valid negative cohorts.

entries.rationale: Primitive-work buckets are the prepared raw-K default for eligible incumbent and quartet-parallel Rys-task producers. Task producers retain the same quartet arithmetic and use four independently retiring warp-private eight-bin queues; explicit component-Rys/block and whole-CTA/native/unsupported classes retain their existing workers. Current joint qualification retains every sample and passes independent matrix/sanitizer, admission-count and complete cold E+F mean/median gates against both standalone policies. Historical unmatched two-sample trajectories and the rejected initial union remain distinct evidence. Explicit fill restores the preceding schedule and smaller task scratch independently of lowering preference.
entries.revisit_condition: Retain finite post-screening queues, unchanged mathematical contracts and explicit fill rollback. Renew source-identified matrix, sanitizer, work-count and complete-endpoint qualification before changing task granularity, work buckets or combining performance claims.

entries.rationale: Unbudgeted strict-FP64 zero-order SPD Coulomb defaults to MD-J for at least eight AOs, within an optional 128-MiB cap after retained normal owners. Public active-ledger plans retain normal J because they reserve no optional MD allowance. Construction-time opt-out 1 retains normal J; K, mixed, response and derivatives keep existing consumers. Original source qualification retains three same-binary cold pairs with independent gates and explicit 17/16 Fock counts.
entries.revisit_condition: Broaden ledger admission only with an explicit optional candidate reserving future owners, rebuild and forces; broaden numerical/workload domains only with renewed independent gates and complete endpoints. Retained GPU receipts remain pinned to their measured source; host resource repairs do not claim new GPU qualification.
